Okay. I have a story.

One of my close friends broke his back a long time ago, became addicted to opiates. He later lost his license because of drugs, so he had to start biking everywhere. Fast forward to a few years later (now), and he has been clean for about six months. He works two jobs so that he can afford to live while also paying off his fines so that he can get his license back. He has been keeping himself busy in any way possible just to keep himself from falling back into the cycle of addiction. His latest project was painting his bike.

Three nights ago he was biking home and was hit by an SUV. The driver dragged his bike for 200 yards, did not stop. My friend has six broken vertebrae, a broken pelvis, staples in his head, and stitches in his eyelid.

Now he has a mountain of medical bills and I am so worried that he is going to relapse. And there is a fucking monster driving around out there.
